The first factorisation filled the device (47.52 GB in use) and failed with ALLOC_FAILED (cuDSSError ALLOC_FAILED (2) in the log). Likely cause, NOT verified: rfx.fdfd._cudss switches hybrid mode on (HybridMemoryModeOptions(hybrid_memory_mode=True)) without a device-memory limit, so cuDSS may not have spilled to the host. The lane env block records cudss_hybrid_memory false at start because the lane switches hybrid on per level (RFX_P_HYBRID_LEVELS); the level-5 record has hybrid_memory true. Level 5 is therefore not measured; the ladder is m = 1-4.
